about: Journeys between consecutive itinerary stops, looked up once (not live). Public-transport minutes are door-to-door including walking, for the stated weekday and departure time; they vary by time of day, day of week and service changes. Walking routes follow streets and footpaths. A route's own `source` overrides the default. Berlin: VBB timetable data via https://v6.vbb.transport.rest, for every hop of 1.5 km or more; Tempelhofer Feld is routed via its Tempelhofer Damm main entrance (Tor 10); Restaurant Anhalt shares the Deutsches Technikmuseum's location, so its journey is the museum's. Singapore: the Transitous journey planner (https://transitous.org, MOTIS) on 2026-10-12, using LTA timetable data for buses and MRT and OpenStreetMap for walking; hops of 1.5 km or more, plus Marina Bay walks where the street route is much longer than the straight line; Singapore Botanic Gardens is routed from Tanglin Gate; National Kitchen shares National Gallery Singapore's location.
source: VBB Verkehrsverbund Berlin-Brandenburg timetable data, via v6.vbb.transport.rest
